text: Change the producer prompt (line 8 says the producer 'may' run the checks) so the producer must run the full `cargo test --locked` before it finishes, even for docs, TOML or data-only changes. Policy and config tests read tracked non-Rust files: boundary words, unlisted file kinds, defaults.toml, and study model.json. A candidate whose full test run is 'not-run' should be sent back to the producer instead of going on to verification.
